live_salary_estimation.reasoning: A developer with 100 repositories, strong breadth across TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and HTML, and focused experience building AI multi-agent ecosystems likely maps to a senior to staff-level full-stack/AI engineer in the US market. The combination of high repository count and modern AI/system-building suggests substantial hands-on experience and portfolio strength, which can command compensation above typical senior software engineer ranges. For US base salary, a reasonable estimate is $180k at the lower end for strong senior roles and up to $320k for staff-level or high-paying market/remote roles, especially at well-funded AI companies. Total compensation could be higher, but this range is for salary only.
